subject: Acme procurement + security follow-up / PO vs card / SOC 2 & DPA
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Bloom <sara.bloom@acme-corp.com>, Tom Harris <tom.harris@acme-corp.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-12T14:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood procurement + security follow-up

Hi Sara / Tom — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and the immediate next steps so we have alignment: 

1) Security gating items you called out:
   - SOC 2 Type II attestation (procurement needs the report or attestation)
   - Data Processing Addendum (DPA) execution
   - Answers to a short security questionnaire (you said procurement will send)

2) Commercial / procurement path discussion:
   - POC / evaluation: recommend card or self-serve for quick start (low friction)
   - Production: recommend PO (standard for Acme); we support both PO and card billing
   - Marketplace: you asked whether we can transact via your supplier marketplace — we can support that if you provide the marketplace vendor ID and required contract terms

3) Action items:
   - I will send SOC 2 attestation and a DPA draft for your legal review (Marissa, by EOD Thursday)
   - Please share the procurement questionnaire and preferred procurement contact (Tom, if procurement needs anything else)
   - Aditya (copied) will be available for any technical/security clarifications

Attachments: call recording (call-recording-20261112.mp3) — stub referenced for note-taking.

If PO is the likely path for production, can you confirm target PO date so we can align legal/finance?

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

From: Tom Harris <tom.harris@acme-corp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Sara Bloom <sara.bloom@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Acme Procurement <procurement@acme-corp.com>
Date: 2026-11-14T09:17:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood procurement + security follow-up

Marissa — thanks for the recap. A few clarifications from procurement side: 

- We require SOC 2 Type II (or equivalent attestation) before we can finalize vendor approval. A SOC 2 letter attesting the scope (data center + SaaS controls) is fine.
- DPA: we need your DPA to be reviewed by our legal team; please send the draft.
- Billing: for production we prefer a standard PO (Net 30). For a short POC we can pay by card, but that requires finance approval.
- Marketplace: we do use an internal marketplace for some vendors. If Redwood is listed in the marketplace, procurement can route payment that way; otherwise we'll do PO direct to Redwood. Which is easier from your side?

Two additional asks: 
1) Our security team will send a short questionnaire (approx ~15 questions) — can your security team aim for 3 business days turnaround?
2) Can you provide an estimated monthly usage / spend for a mid-sized POC (100k tokens/month) so I can get an internal PO estimate?

If you can share the SOC 2 and DPA draft, I'll route them to legal and procurement.

Thanks — Tom
Tom Harris
Head of Procurement Operations, Acme Corp
tharris@acme-corp.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Harris <tom.harris@acme-corp.com>, Sara Bloom <sara.bloom@acme-corp.com>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acme-corp.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, dev_patel <dev@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood procurement + security follow-up

Hi Tom — attaching the askables below. Per your list: 

- Attachment: Redwood-SOC2-Attestation.pdf (SOC 2 Type II attestation covering SaaS controls)
- Attachment: DPA_Draft_Acme_20261118.docx (editable Word DPA for your legal)

Quick answers: 
- Marketplace: we can transact via marketplace or direct PO. If you want marketplace, please share the vendor ID and any contract terms required; otherwise PO to Redwood Inference is straightforward. 
- Questionnaire turnaround: Aditya (copied) will be the security point-of-contact. He can aim for a 3 business day turnaround once we receive the questionnaire.
- Usage estimate: for 100k tokens/month on the Redwood Hosted plan our rough estimate is $1,200–$1,800/month depending on model mix and streaming vs batch. I will follow up with a short sample invoice.

Next steps I propose:
1) Legal: review the attached DPA and flag any redlines — Dev (copied) can help on contractual questions from our side.
2) Procurement: confirm whether marketplace or PO (and if PO, expected PO issuance date).
3) Security: send the questionnaire; Aditya will respond within 3 business days.

Attachments included: Redwood-SOC2-Attestation.pdf, DPA_Draft_Acme_20261118.docx

Let me know if you'd like a short sync to walk legal/procurement through the DPA.

Best — Marissa

From: procurement@acme-corp.com <procurement@acme-corp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, dev_patel <dev@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Harris <tom.harris@acme-corp.com>, Sara Bloom <sara.bloom@acme-corp.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T11:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood procurement + security follow-up

Marissa / Aditya — procurement reviewed the attachments. A couple of open items before we can issue a PO: 

1) DPA: legal had a small set of redlines around subprocessor notice and data deletion timelines. We will share a marked copy by EOD Monday.
2) SSO & Audit Logs: security needs details on SSO (SAML/SCIM support) and where audit logs live (retention and access). Can Aditya provide a short doc?
3) Invoice estimate: please provide a sample monthly invoice / estimate so we can build the PO amount. We need a ballpark number by Thursday 2026-11-20 to get finance signoff.

Procurement prefers PO (Net 30) for production. For the POC we may process a credit card payment to expedite evaluation. Please confirm whether Redwood needs a signed MSA or if we can sign the DPA and PO as the commercial instrument.

Thanks — Procurement
Acme Corp Procurement Team
procurement@acme-corp.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: procurement@acme-corp.com, Tom Harris <tom.harris@acme-corp.com>, Sara Bloom <sara.bloom@acme-corp.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, dev_patel <dev@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-20T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood procurement + security follow-up

Thanks for the quick review — appreciate the detail. Quick replies and next steps from our side: 

- DPA redlines: happy to review the marked copy. Our legal (Dev) will respond with tracked changes within 24–48 hours of receiving your redlines.
- SSO & Audit logs: Aditya will prepare a 1-page SSO/SCIM summary and an audit-logs/retention note; I’ll ask him to send it over today.
- Invoice / PO estimate: attached is a sample invoice estimate for the 100k tokens/month scenario (Redwood-invoice-estimate-ACME-20261120.pdf). This assumes a mixed model profile; if you want a narrower model selection I can tighten the estimate.

About the MSA vs PO: we typically accept PO + DPA for customers that have standard commercial terms; an MSA is optional. If your legal wants an MSA, we can provide one but it will add one review cycle. If procurement can execute via PO + DPA that will be the fastest path to production.

Can you confirm the desired PO issuance date so we can set up billing and provision any needed Dedicated capacity? If you expect > 1M tokens/month or need guarantees, let me know and we can scope Dedicated/pricing options.

Happy to jump on a 20-min call to close blockers — propose tomorrow at 10:00 AM PT if that works.

Attachments: Redwood-invoice-estimate-ACME-20261120.pdf

Thanks — Marissa
